author: Daniele Morais
title: Tropical cyclone: alerta orange for Mexico
seoTitle: Tropical cyclone in Mexico: alert orange
subtitle: The global disaster alert system rates event "POLO-26" at orange (moderate to high) level.
excerpt: Tropical cyclone puts Mexico under orange (moderate to high) alert in the international GDACS system.
contentHtml:
GDACS, the global disaster alert and coordination system run by the UN and the European Commission, issued a orange (moderate to high) alert for event "POLO-26" (tropical cyclone) affecting Mexico.

From the official bulletin: From 21/09/2026 to 24/09/2026, a Hurricane/Typhoon > 74 mph (maximum wind speed of 287 km/h) POLO-26 was active in EastPacific. The cyclone affects these countries: Mexico (vulnerability Medium). Estimated population affected by category 1 (120 km/h) wind speeds or higher is 23941 .

What the alert level means

GDACS rates events green, orange or red based on estimated humanitarian impact — exposed population, regional vulnerability and local response capacity.

With data from GDACS (Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System).
